items.title: ALAB Benefits From Strong PCIe Demand: Can It Beat MRVL & CRDO?
items.summary: Astera Labs (ALAB) is capitalizing on strong demand for PCIe connectivity solutions and AI infrastructure investments. The company's Scorpio AI fabric portfolio exceeded $1 billion in annualized revenue in Q3 2026, while the newly launched Aries 7 portfolio expands PCIe Gen 7 opportunities. ALAB expects Q4 2026 revenues of $730M-$750M, representing 27% sequential growth. However, the company faces intense competition from Marvell Technology and Credo Technology, both expanding their connectivity portfolios.
